Subject: Request: short bridge credits + trial extension for OpenVoice pilot

Hi Olga,

Thanks for the prior demo — the team at OpenVoice is excited to get the transcription pilot running at scale. We have one practical timing problem: our foundation grant that will fund the pilot is delayed by ~6 weeks (final award sign-off shifted to mid-September). That leaves us with a hard start-window in the next 10 days, but no committed credits in place yet.

Would Redwood consider a small bridge of usage credits and a short trial extension so we can run initial batches and complete our IRB/field test before the formal grant arrives? Specifically we are asking for:
- 250k token credits (to cover two weeks of transcription runs)
- 30-day trial extension on our account

I attached our grant timeline and a brief LOI so you can see the funding schedule and why we need a short-term bridge. If helpful, finance at OpenVoice can sign a payment commitment that the grant will cover charges retroactively and can provide PO details once the award is received.

We’re a 501(c)(3) with a small team (links in LOI). Pilot results will be shared openly with Redwood and we’re happy to include Redwood as a project sponsor in the interim materials.

Appreciate any help — happy to jump on a quick call.

Attachments: grant_timeline.pdf (pdf), openvoice_loi.docx (docx)

Warmly,
Lara Nguyen
Program Director, OpenVoice
lara@openvoice.org | +1 (415) 555-0138
